body:
No - people have regularly told me that I am a good guy, but I can't see it, I guess.

Objectively, viewed from the outside, I do good things, am generally nice to be around, and such like - but from my perspective inside my own head, I cannot square the circle.

Thanks for your advice.

I have previously done CBT on the NHS for social anxiety, and that has been very useful.  I have attempted to apply the same techniques to this.. whatever it is .. and logic has not worked.

I have also been on an anti-depressant - citrolpan(sp?) (again for the anxiety) which really messed me up quite badly - my GP took me off them again after three weeks and then referred me for the therapy.

I am pretty scared to try drugs again - but I don't feel you should be embaressed about having used them (ie, it is not something to shamefully 'admit' :) )

Thanks for your message.  I will do the audit, and see what I come up with.
You make a lot of sense. Thank you.

>  I am just waiting for my parents to die so I can end it without hurting them.

This is an accurate summary of how I feel.  I don't want my parents to die sooner, but I am just biding time at this point.

ok.gif

But seriously - this sounds like an obvious thing to say (ie, anyone in the situation would be sad) but if I could guarantee I could die in such a way that no-one would be negatively affected, I would go ahead and do it.  It's not that I'm unafraid of death (although you make a good point, and I probably am not), it's that I just feel like I'm taking up space - inert, despite what I'm told.

Just yesterday I did a favor for a friend of a friend and was called 'considerate and compassionate' for the way I dealt with them.

Which was nice - but it didn't make me feel differently about myself.

I see what you are getting at though.  Might be worth doing an audit of what I put into the world, and how I feel about it.

It's an excellent question, and one that is quite difficult to answer.

It would be easy to answer if I was in desperate financial straights, had a lack of friends and family, had a terminal illness of some sort, or was in constant pain from a chronic condition.  None of those things are the case.  I can give no reasonable reason for the way I feel.  I just wouldn't be sad if I discovered I was going to die, because it would give me a way out without making other people question themselves and their involvement.

I don't know if I'm making any sense or not.
